URL semantics: when via_gnews=yes, `url` is an article-specific Google News REDIRECT (a discovery link, not the canonical publisher URL); `resolved_url` is the decoded publisher article when available, else blank; `publisher_url` is the outlet homepage (provenance only — never the article). For non-gnews rows, `url` is the native article URL.
